changelog: 1.0.0 (2026-10-14): initial weights and pass rule from the content pipeline guide, Step 05.

1.1.0 (2026-10-14): visuals. Hook anchor: a cover visual that shows the promise can lift 4 to 5; Flow anchor 3 now includes three or more text-only slides in a row. Lint checks text inside visuals and warns on text-only runs (no caps).

2.0.0 (2026-10-14): shares-first. Added Send-worthy (20%, must be 4+) and Caption (8%) lines; reweighted the six existing lines; caption and engagement-bait lint checks. Evidence: references/engagement-research.md.

2.1.0 (2026-10-14): free themes. A theme with "brand": "free" is off-brand by design; lint checks it against its own palette and fonts, and the Brand line is scored as Design (Instagram craft) with its own anchors.

3.0.0 (2026-10-14): Instagram house rules merged from the owner's carousel-post-review skill. Hard gates G1-G10 (any failure blocks a pass); 6 slides max; 34px minimum for all text; no slide numbers, no kicker, BUILDABLELABS.COM footer; judge also returns gate rulings and 'why might this NOT get engagement' risks. Scoring stays shares-first for Instagram.

3.1.0 (2026-10-15): checks borrowed from the ig-carousel/ig-caption/ig-human and linkedin-carousel-builder skills. Render: measured contrast of every text run against what is painted under it (error under 3:1, warn under 4.5:1 for text under 48px), light font weights. Copy: machine-written sentence shapes ('It's not X, it's Y', 'not only/but also', one-word question lines, shouted runs), numbers spelled as words on slides, invisible characters, a longer stock-phrase list. Caption: links, weak openers, emoji density, junk hashtags, search terms from brief.md '## Search terms' (caption and alt text), and the feed preview line.

3.2.0 (2026-10-15): story framework. carousel-make picks PAS (readers underestimate the problem) or PPP (readers doubt the fix) and records it in brief.md '## Story'; the Flow 4 anchor now includes a framework that doesn't fit the reader; lint notes a missing '## Story' (info, no cap).

pass.note: Instagram first. Every gate must pass; then 4.0+ weighted, no line below 3, Send-worthy 4+.

lines.name: Send-worthy
lines.asks: Would a reader DM this to a specific person? Clear who-to-send-to, one standalone sendable slide, a real surprise or fix, makes the sender look sharp.

lines.name: Hook slide
lines.asks: Stops the scroll in 0.5 seconds: specific, surprising, 10 words or fewer, a slide-1 infographic that shows the promise, readable in the grid crop.

lines.name: Story flow
lines.asks: Headlines alone tell the story; problem, pain, the obvious fix fails, BUT, insight, how, CTA; no answer before the BUT; slide 2 works as a second cover.

lines.name: Value
lines.asks: Worth saving: a checklist, steps, framework or sourced number; concrete specifics; a beginner gets it immediately.

lines.name: Readability
lines.asks: Each slide read in 3 seconds on a phone: one focal point, visual 40-60% of the slide, the type scale, strong contrast, balanced space.

lines.name: Brand / design
lines.asks: Brand themes: ours (palette, fonts, theme, footer, voice) and a clean render. Free themes: design quality for Instagram.

lines.name: Call to action
lines.asks: One honest ask tied to the payoff (send, save, or a question to the reader), ideally a callback to the hook; no bait, no promotion.

lines.name: Caption
lines.asks: Line 1 is a second hook before '...more'; adds what the slides don't; searchable keywords; one ask; 3-5 precise hashtags.

wrong_size.why: Instagram will crop or letterbox it.

overflow.why: Text is clipped on the slide.

words_over.why: A slide is over the word limit.

font_too_small.why: Reading text is too small for a phone.

font_fallback.why: A brand font failed to load; the render used a fallback.

font_off_brand.why: The vision uses a font that is not in brand.json.

colour_off_brand.why: The vision uses a colour that is not in brand.json.

vision_not_locked.why: The look was never locked with the designer.

cover_way_long.why: The cover headline is far past 10 words.

cover_long.why: The cover headline is over 10 words.

too_few_slides.why: Too short for the swipe to build.

unsourced_number.why: A number on a slide is not in the brief's evidence.

stat_without_source.why: A stat slide has no source line.

unverified_evidence.why: A number comes from evidence the brief marks as unverified or test data.

no_cta.why: The last slide is not a call to action.

cta_no_action.why: The CTA never says what to do.

cta_many_asks.why: The CTA asks for more than one thing.

unknown_theme.why: The vision names a theme that doesn't exist.

caption_too_long.why: The caption is over Instagram's 2,200-character limit.

caption_hook_long.why: The caption's first line runs past the '...more' cut.

caption_many_asks.why: The caption asks for more than one thing.

hashtags_many.why: More than 5 hashtags; they classify a post, they don't spread it.

engagement_bait.why: Engagement bait (tag/comment/like-if prompts) gets posts demoted.

slide_no_visual.why: A slide with no visual is a wall of words in the feed (gate G1).

slide_numbers.why: Slide numbers on the slides (gate G7).

low_contrast_text.why: Some text is hard to read against what's behind it.

light_weight.why: A light font weight disappears at phone size.

caption_link.why: Caption links aren't clickable; it reads as off-platform.

invisible_chars.why: Invisible characters from pasted AI text.

gates.name: Visual on every slide
gates.fails_when: Any slide is text-only or has only a decorative object; or slide 1 has no infographic (a visual with information in it).

gates.name: No dead space
gates.fails_when: Any slide has an empty area over about 20% of the slide that reads as a gap (e.g. a full-width band taller than ~270px, or a ~600x600px empty block).

gates.name: No overlaps
gates.fails_when: Text overlaps text or objects, objects collide, anything is hidden or clipped, or a highlight block touches the line above or below.

gates.name: Nothing under 34px
gates.fails_when: Any text anywhere (labels, chips, diagram text, footer) is under 34px at 1080px width.

gates.name: No logo
gates.fails_when: The Buildable Labs mark or wordmark appears anywhere, in any variant. The plain-text footer BUILDABLELABS.COM is not a logo.

gates.name: No slide numbers
gates.fails_when: Any counter or page number: '01 / 06', '3/7', numbered slide labels, giant ghost numerals.

gates.name: No self-promotion
gates.fails_when: The CTA or any slide promotes Buildable Labs or its services ('we help...', 'book a call', 'free consultation').

gates.name: Every number sourced
gates.fails_when: A number on a slide, in a visual or in the caption isn't in brief.md's evidence, or comes from evidence marked unverified.

gates.name: No engagement bait
gates.fails_when: 'Tag a friend', 'comment YES', 'comment MOD for the link', 'like if', 'share if': Instagram demotes posts built to inflate engagement.
